name: Andre Kowalczyk
summary: Warehouse supervisor with 7 years of people leadership in high-volume GTA distribution centres and 10 years in warehousing overall. Supervises a team of 20 on rotating day/night shifts, daily Manhattan WMS user, forklift certified, WHMIS 2015 trained and JHSC Certified Member. Canadian permanent resident with an Ontario G licence; English fluent, Polish conversational.
skills: Forklift certified (counterbalance, reach truck, order picker)

experience.description: Supervise 20 associates and 2 lead hands on a rotating 4-on/4-off day/night shift in a 300,000 sq ft retail DC in Mississauga shipping 45,000 units per day. Labour planning in Manhattan WMS, raised pick accuracy from 99.1% to 99.7%, cut dock-to-stock from 36 to 22 hours, 26 months without a lost-time injury on shift, coaching, discipline and performance reviews.

Supervised 12-16 associates on nights in Brampton for three e-commerce clients. Peak season staffing with temp agencies, zone cycle count program above 99.5% accuracy, Manhattan WMS go-live super-user who trained 40+ staff.
Led a crew of 6 on inbound receiving and outbound LTL/FTL loading in Etobicoke; carrier paperwork, OS&D resolution, trained new forklift operators.
Picking, packing, putaway and replenishment using counterbalance and reach trucks.

education.degree: Diploma, Supply Chain and Operations Management
education.institution: Lakeshore College of Applied Arts and Technology
